about: Scene edits applied by optimize.mjs --edits. Angles/heights are the site's rest pose; see edits.mjs for the coordinate conventions. Donor foliage comes from the capture's back-right hedge (theta 84-122), off-screen in every standard view (only a 21:9 window at full right drag shows a sliver of it at the far edge), so no clone appears next to its source.

clear.name: gap-white-dots
clear.note: Sparse pale shell splats where the back-right capture has no data: read as a white wall behind the trees. Hidden behind the new foliage anyway.

clear.name: edge-house
clear.note: White/grey house wall glimpsed through the trees at the right edge of the orbit (full right drag, ultrawide). Replaced by the house-cover patch.

clear.name: left-washed-blobs
clear.note: Sun-washed background foliage on the left: a few dozen huge (0.12-0.6u), low-detail pale sage splats that read as a flat white-green smear behind the left tree. Replaced by the left-bushes patch.

clear.name: left-edge-blobs
clear.note: More of the same washed blobs at the lower-left screen edge, where the background also leaked through behind the dark near-left bush. Below the horizon, so bluish blobs go too.

clear.name: far-left-structure
clear.note: Grey/white wall under a dark roof line at the left edge of the orbit (full left drag) - the left-hand twin of edge-house. Replaced by the far-left-cover patch.

clear.name: near-camera-blue-a
clear.note: Sky reflected in the leaves of a plant right beside the camera: a blue-white smear at the bottom-right when the orbit tilts down. The leaves themselves stay.

clear.name: near-camera-blue-b
clear.note: Sky reflected in the leaves of a plant right beside the camera: a blue-white smear at the bottom-right when the orbit tilts down. The leaves themselves stay.

clear.name: left-canopy-flecks
clear.note: Sun-glare 'white leaves' scattered through the big left tree's canopy: pale splats much brighter than their 32 nearest neighbours. Canopy only (above the lawn, in front of the dome).

patches.name: front-hedge
patches.note: Back-right gap, front row: the hedge set down on the gap's ground (1.17u lower than the donor's) and scaled 1.2x to reach the pines.

patches.name: back-row
patches.note: Back-right gap, second row: mirrored, pushed back and raised so it peeks over the front row; slightly larger splats read as softer, deeper foliage and close pin-holes.

patches.name: house-cover
patches.note: Foliage in front of where the edge-house wall was.

patches.name: left-bushes
patches.note: Real foliage where the sun-washed blobs were; palette pulled toward a healthy mid green rather than the washed-out neighbours.

patches.name: far-left-cover
patches.note: Foliage over the far-left structure; mirrored so the donor's canopy lands on this side.

patches.name: left-edge-bush
patches.note: Low bush at the lower-left capture edge, where the ground was never captured and the background showed through at the bottom-left of the default view. Sits just behind the real (dark) near-left bush.
